tiers.summary: Entry raids for small parties learning the flow.

roleReward.unlockAnnouncementText: Congratulations on clearing your first Bronze raid. You have now unlocked the next raid tier!

tiers.name: Silver Raids
tiers.summary: Harder static bosses for parties with stronger rolls.

roleReward.unlockAnnouncementText: Congratulations on clearing your first Silver raid. You have now unlocked the next raid tier!

tiers.name: Gold Raids
tiers.summary: Endgame siege bosses for fully built parties chasing the top raid clear.

roleReward.unlockAnnouncementText: Congratulations on clearing your first Gold raid. You have conquered the highest raid tier now available!

copy.recruitmentSummary: A brittle drake circles the ruined tower.
copy.successSummary: The Bone Drake collapses into splinters.
copy.failureSummary: The Bone Drake escapes the tower ruins.

copy.recruitmentSummary: A plated mimic guards the vault door.
copy.successSummary: The Iron Mimic falls apart around the loot.
copy.failureSummary: The Iron Mimic seals the vault and withdraws.

copy.recruitmentSummary: A storm-forged sentinel blocks the summit path.
copy.successSummary: The Storm Warden shatters under the party's assault.
copy.failureSummary: The Storm Warden drives the party from the summit.

copy.recruitmentSummary: A tyrant of molten gold rises above the eclipse gate, devouring the light around the arena.
copy.successSummary: The Sun-Eater King breaks apart in a rain of burning gold and the eclipse finally lifts.
copy.failureSummary: The Sun-Eater King devours the last light and leaves the arena in ruin.

copy.panelDescription: Pick a tier, gather a party, and take down a raid boss.
